baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from blocking the way and the Sacred Mosque to its being made for people equally, resident and outsider.
baseline_models.mechanism: A traversable way terminates in a protected worship place whose divinely assigned condition is equal human use. The attached resident and the arriving open-country outsider are contrasted precisely to cancel local privilege, so diversion from the route frustrates the sanctuary's designed social function.

activation_trace.role: Turning away or diverting supplies the active blockage that interrupts access.
An extended traversable road supplies the access line on which the blockage operates.
A place of prostration supplies the destination as a functional worship place rather than an abstract emblem.
A spatial sanctuary with protected appurtenances supplies the bounded place whose access must be preserved.
Making something into a specified condition supplies equality as designed status, not accidental custom.
Manifest humanity supplies the unrestricted human constituency for whom the place was made.
Equivalence between two parties supplies the governing relation between resident and outsider.
Devoted attachment and remaining supply the locally established user in the equality pair.
Open-country life outside the town supplies the arriving nonlocal user whose access cannot be subordinated.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers bar people from God's path and the Sacred Mosque.
changed_reading.after: They obstruct a divinely constituted equal-access sanctuary: a traversable way and worship place made for human use without resident privilege over the arriving outsider.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Whoever intends within it an ilhad by zulm is made to taste painful punishment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Volition initiates a directional sequence: intention inclines toward a side, zulm places conduct or rights where they do not belong, and punishment becomes experienced taste. The clause therefore monitors an incipient distortion of the sanctuary's just arrangement, not only a completed external act.

activation_trace.role: Will and purposive inclination supply the initiating state before outward completion.
Inclination toward an edge supplies the directional deformation inside the sanctuary.
Putting something in the wrong sensible place supplies misplacement as the manner of deviation.
Withholding and confining a right supplies the social effect of the spatial misplacement.
Experiential testing supplies the conversion of intended distortion into personally known consequence.
Punitive pain supplies the sanction attached to the distorted arrangement.
The quality of causing pain intensifies the sanction as an imposed felt condition.

changed_reading.before: Whoever intends wrongdoing there will receive painful punishment.
changed_reading.after: Even the purposive beginning of a sideward, rights-displacing deformation within the sanctuary enters a sequence in which deviation is made experientially felt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, guidance is repeated around wholesome speech and a praised straight road. This turns the focus way into a communicated and actively guided route, so blocking can work by corrupting orientation and discourse as well as by physically denying entry.

activation_trace.role: The traversable way supplies the focus route whose guidance is clarified by the preceding verse.
Diversion supplies the counterforce that can interrupt both movement and orientation.
Repeated gentle direction to a road or truth supplies active wayfinding on both sides of the verse.
Wholesomeness opposed to corruption qualifies the speech that carries the route's orientation.
Uttered speech supplies the communicative medium through which the route is made intelligible.
A straight road supplies a directional parallel that sharpens the focus way.

structural_cues: 22:24 repeats guidance before and after wholesome speech, then names a praised road immediately before 22:25 names diversion from God's way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated guidance, wholesome speech, a straight road, and then diversion; I infer that speech performs route maintenance. A live alternative is that 22:24 merely stacks ethical synonyms without specifying how the obstruction works.

changed_reading.before: The blockage is principally denial of movement toward a sacred destination.
changed_reading.after: The blockage can also deform the wholesome speech and orientation by which people recognize and travel the sacred route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier figures bend a side to mislead from the way and worship from an edge before reversing onto the face. Those embodied turns activate an axis in the focus between fair center and lateral ilhad: obstruction is produced by a posture that biases shared space toward an edge and can flip with circumstance.

activation_trace.role: Inclination to an edge supplies the focus term's lateral component.
A just middle and equitable place supply the center from which lateral distortion departs.
Folding and turning supply the first bodily torque in the misleading posture.
Turning the side in refusal supplies an embodied mechanism for redirecting others.
Departure from guidance supplies the effect that the twisted posture seeks on the shared way.
Inclination from a direction supplies edge-positioned worship as an unstable spatial analogue.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal that exposes the edge posture's instability.

structural_cues: 22:9 joins a bent side directly to misleading from God's way; 22:11 places worship on an edge and then describes a reversal on the face.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies side-bending, edge-positioning, reversal, a fair middle, and lateral ilhad; I infer one spatial axis linking them. A live alternative is that the earlier body language is idiomatic and does not define the focus term.

changed_reading.before: Ilhad is a general impious intention committed in a sacred place.
changed_reading.after: Ilhad is also legible as an edge-producing turn that displaces the sanctuary's fair center and redirects people traveling its way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The House is purified for moving and postural users, then a public pilgrimage call draws arrivals through every distant pass. Equal resident-outsider access is therefore operational: purity keeps the shared site usable, circumambulation keeps it circulating, and open passes feed nonlocal arrivals into it.

activation_trace.role: The worship place supplies the institutional destination of the circulation system.
Designed condition supplies equality as a maintained operating rule.
Equivalence supplies the admission rule for different user classes.
Ritual residence in the mosque supplies the locally attached user of the House.
The open-country outsider supplies the incoming user produced by the pilgrimage routes.
A house as shelter and dwelling supplies the shared site's concrete, maintained interior.
Removal of contamination supplies the maintenance needed to keep the shared House usable.
Movement around a center supplies organized circulation within the House.
Purposeful travel toward the magnified place supplies the inbound movement.
A broad pass opened between mountains supplies the physical channels of arrival.
Depth and remoteness of road supply the long-range reach that makes outsider equality consequential.

structural_cues: 22:26 assigns purification to the House for circling, standing, bowing, and prostrating users.
22:27 follows with a public call and arrivals through every distant pass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a maintained House, circulating worshipers, a public call, and remote ingress; I infer that these operations implement the equality stated in 22:25. A live alternative is that the verses list adjacent ritual duties without specifying an access system.

changed_reading.before: Equality is a static legal status shared by resident and outsider.
changed_reading.after: Equality is an operating design for a purified House whose internal circulation and distant approach routes must remain usable to both.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival is purposive: people witness benefits and the provision is eaten and actively fed to the distressed poor. Access to the sanctuary therefore carries a distributive output, making obstruction an interception of material benefit as well as ritual movement.

activation_trace.role: Diversion supplies the possible upstream interruption of the pilgrimage's downstream benefits.
Humanity as the designated constituency supplies the broad beneficiary class.
Equal relation supplies the norm against concentrating the benefits in local hands.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the explicit purpose witnessed by those who arrive.
Allocated provision supplies the material stock moving through the rite.
Eating the food supplies participant consumption within the distribution.
Feeding another supplies the outward transfer rather than mere private consumption.
Constricted living supplies the distressed recipient condition addressed by the transfer.
Material need supplies the recipient whose inclusion reveals the access system's distributive end.

structural_cues: The purpose clause in 22:28 follows the arrival sequence and coordinates participant eating with feeding the distressed poor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, benefits, allotted provision, eating, and feeding the poor; I infer a flow from open access to material distribution. A live alternative is that the benefits and feeding are adjacent pilgrimage effects rather than part of what the focus obstruction blocks.

changed_reading.before: Blocking the sanctuary denies a worship opportunity.
changed_reading.after: Blocking the sanctuary can also dam a public flow of benefits and provision meant to reach participants and the poor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later counterfactual links unjust expulsion to divine repelling that prevents demolition across several kinds of worship place. The focus sanctuary is thus one node in a defended worship ecology: its sacred protection opposes removal and destruction rather than authorizing possessive exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Diversion supplies the focus form of exclusion from worship access.
Protected inviolability and right supply sacredness as a claim to preservation.
Withholding and confinement from a right supply the injustice performed by exclusion.
Forced passage to the outside supplies expulsion as the enlarged form of denied access.
Pushing away harm supplies the counterforce that preserves access and structures.
Pulling down a building supplies the destruction prevented by that counterforce.
The church-specific branch supplies another worship structure inside the protected set.
Places of prayer supply a further worship-site class preserved from demolition.
Mosques as places of prostration reconnect the plural preservation sequence directly to the focus destination.

structural_cues: 22:39 authorizes defense because people were wronged; 22:40 specifies expulsion without right and a demolition counterfactual spanning multiple worship places.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, protective repelling, threatened demolition, and a plural list of worship sites; I infer that repelling maintains a worship-access ecology. A live alternative is that 22:40 concerns general preservation while 22:25 remains only a local sanctuary offense.

changed_reading.before: The focus threatens punishment for a local violation of one sacred precinct.
changed_reading.after: The threat aligns with a wider anti-expulsion and anti-demolition rule that preserves access to worship sites, including the focus mosque.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes with another making construction: no constriction was made upon the community in religion, followed by holding fast. Read against the focus making of the sanctuary for equal use, legitimate sacred order protects and binds without becoming a human choke point; obstruction counterfeit-sacralizes constriction.

activation_trace.role: Making into a condition supplies the focus design of equal sanctuary use.
Protected right supplies sacred boundary as preservation rather than arbitrary narrowing.
Diversion supplies the humanly imposed constriction that opposes the designed condition.
Equal relation supplies the nonconstrictive effect of the focus design.
The repeated making construction supplies a whole-surah design comparison with the focus.
Obedient religious order supplies the domain explicitly declared free of imposed constriction.
Narrowness and difficulty supply the condition explicitly negated from religious design.
Protective holding supplies a positive form of binding that preserves rather than chokes.

structural_cues: 22:25 says the sanctuary was made for people equally; 22:78 says no constriction was made upon the community in religion and then commands protective holding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched making constructions, equal use, negated constriction, and protective holding; I infer a design contrast between sacred protection and obstructive narrowing. A live alternative is that the final no-constriction clause concerns legal burden without spatial implications.

changed_reading.before: Sacredness is primarily a restrictive boundary whose violation is punished.
changed_reading.after: Sacredness is a protective, nonconstrictive order; turning its boundary into a choke point violates the very condition for which it was made.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because equal sanctuary access can be overread as declaring all rites equivalent. It remains anchored in the focus equality of resident and outsider and in 22:67-69's sequence of every community having a rite, restraint from mutual struggle, and deferred judgment. Downstream prose should present only a capacity for differentiated ritual routes to coexist without human gatekeeping, not theological sameness or unrestricted ritual claims.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sanctuary is made for people equally across the resident-outsider distinction.

activation_trace.role: Manifest humanity supplies the broad class whose access precedes subgroup distinctions.
Equivalence supplies a shared access relation without requiring identity of practice.
Attached devotion supplies one socially and ritually situated user.
The nonlocal open-country user supplies difference held inside the equality relation.
A community or kind supplies differentiated collective identities.
A specified place and act of ritual supply differentiated practices attached to communities.
Mutual pulling between parties supplies the struggle that the verse restrains.
Twisted contention supplies the discursive form of rival gatekeeping.
Judgment between parties supplies the final decision deferred to God rather than seized by access controllers.

changed_reading.before: Equality means admitting two geographic classes into one uniform ritual identity.
changed_reading.after: Equality may support shared access across real social and ritual differentiation while withholding final judgment from human gatekeepers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain civic activation, not a claim that 22:45 directly explains the mosque blockade. It remains anchored in the sanctuary made for people equally and in focus zulm as misplacement or withholding rights: the later image leaves a communal well idle beside a fortified palace in an emptied settlement. Downstream prose should qualify it as an infrastructural analogy in which public-use systems fail while monumental enclosure survives.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The place made for people equally is obstructed through a zulm that can misplace things and withhold rights.

activation_trace.role: Designed condition supplies the sanctuary as public-use infrastructure.
Humanity supplies the constituency against which civic utility is measured.
A just middle and equitable place supply the public norm distorted by unequal enclosure.
Withholding and confinement from a right supply the social failure projected into the later civic image.
People gathered in a settlement supply the civic scale of the outlier.
Vacancy and emptiness supply the endpoint of failed common life.
A communal water excavation supplies public-use infrastructure.
Vacancy and disabling supply the well's loss of public function.
An enclosed building supplies the surviving monumental counterpoint to the idle well.
Raised and strengthened construction intensifies the asymmetry between monument and disabled common resource.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns an isolated act of gatekeeping at a ritual site.
changed_reading.after: The focus can expose a civic pattern in which a place made for common use is captured, public flows go idle, and monumental enclosure outlives the people it should serve.

strongest_changes: Equal access became an operating circulation system linking a maintained House to distant approach routes.
Sanctuary access acquired a distributive output in benefits and food, and later defense opposed expulsion and demolition across worship sites.
Ilhad became a lateral, edge-producing deformation of a fair center, while the closing no-constriction clause distinguished sacred protection from obstructive narrowing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted the focus from a static prohibition into mechanisms of route guidance, spatial centering, circulation, provision, preservation, and nonconstrictive protection, while leaving live but contained civic and differentiated-rite outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact grammatical relation between ilhad and zulm may be one compounded manner or nested qualification.
The plural worship-site preservation sequence may govern the focus mosque directly or function only as a strong analogy.
The distributive, differentiated-rite, and civic-infrastructure readings should remain activation-level claims unless further evidence independently supports them.
